title: Facility Manager / Operations Manager / Plant Manager
text:
**About the Role**

Our transloading facility at Black, a grain operation just east of Friona on US 60, is hiring a Facility Manager to run the site. This is a hands on job. You manage the crew, you keep trucks and railcars moving, and you run our steam flaking (wheat) and extrusion (milo) processes. If you have led a crew, you know your way around equipment, and you want to run a facility instead of a shift, we would like to hear from you.

**Responsibilities**

* Run day to day operations at the Black facility and set the daily schedule for the crew
* Supervise, train and hold accountable a crew of loader and plant operators
* Make sure trucks are loaded and unloaded on time using our large front-end loaders
* Manage railcar unloading and turn times so cars do not sit
* Manage the steam flaking and extrusion processes, including run settings, product quality and throughput
* Keep loaders, forklifts, the flaker, the extruder and the handling system in good working order
* Troubleshoot mechanical and equipment problems

**Qualifications**

* Previous supervisory or management experience. Grain, feed, dairy, feedyard, oilfield, construction and manufacturing all translate
* Bilingual English and Spanish strongly preferred, since much of our crew speaks Spanish
* Real mechanical ability. You can diagnose an engine, a hydraulic issue or a conveyor problem yourself before calling anyone
* A problem solver who makes the call rather than waiting for permission
* Grain processing experience preferred. Flaking, extruding, roller mills, elevators or feed milling
* Front-end loader and forklift experience preferred

**What you get**

* Small operation, no layers of management. You report straight to ownership, you have real authority over how the site runs, and when you fix something you see the result the same week.
* Health Insurance
* Opportunity to grow with us as a company

**Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM, with Saturday mornings during busy stretches.

Pay: $70,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
